{{Quote|This is Admiral Wieler on the ''Resilient'', calling General Plo&hellip;an enemy starship has entered the system. All fighters &ndash; that vessel must not reach the surface!|Admiral Wieler, during the Battle of Khorm|<ref name="K1" />}}
'''Wieler''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Wieler and their [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]], including Wieler's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Resilient (Venator-class)|''Resilient'']], were paired with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], and [[Tauht]]. The [[Task force/Legends|task force]] was ordered to free the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]], in order to obtain the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] that was found there.

Using a [[weather-control station]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces prevented the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] from sending more reinforcements to the planet, leaving Wieler to set up a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of Khorm. Sometime later, a [[Trident (starship)/Legends|Separatist ship]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] broke through the blockade and was able to reach the surface, despite Wieler's attempts to stop it. Later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were able to destroy the weather-control station, allowing Wieler to send in more reinforcements, which helped the Republic to win the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|battle]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The storm is breaking up!''"<br />"''Launch reinforcements.|A subordinate and Wieler, after the storm breaks up|<ref name="K1" />}}
Wieler was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Wieler served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] as an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] on their [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Resilient (Venator-class)|''Resilient'']].<ref name="K1" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|201}} Furthermore, since ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]'' takes place shortly prior to "Holocron Heist," ''In Service of the Republic'' can also be dated to 22 BBY.</ref> Wieler's [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was dispatched to [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|free]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] control and secure the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits found on the world. The Republic ground forces were led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]], while Wieler was in command of the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] above Khorm. The Separatists, however, had built a [[weather-control station]], which created a storm in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Khorm, preventing the Republic from using air support. Nevertheless, the Republic ground forces were able to land, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-led [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] soon captured an enemy [[agrocite processing facility]].<ref name="K1" />

[[File:Khorm_space.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Wieler's forces in orbit above Khorm]]
Meanwhile, the Separatist [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] arrived in orbit above Khorm in her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Trident/Legends|Trident]]'', to assist the Confederate ground forces. Wieler contacted Koon and ordered two [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]] to prevent the ''Trident'' from making it to the planet. However, the storm opened for Ventress' ship to pass but immediately closed when the Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] went in, and both fighters were destroyed. Wieler contacted Koon via a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and told the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] that the storm had recovered to full strength and that the atmospheric distortion was close to the Jedi's primary objective: the main Separatist base.<ref name="K1" /> After a while, the Jedi were able to destroy the weather-control station, and Wieler immediately dispatched reinforcements to the planet, which rescued the Republic forces from being routed.<ref name="K2">[[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]]</ref> Although the Republic had taken severe losses, they were able to win the battle and secure the agrocite [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="CW9">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The enemy got through and &hellip;the storm re-formed to full strength. Our fighters were lost. The atmospheric distortion is centered near your primary objective.|Admiral Wieler briefs Jedi Generals Koon and Fisto|<ref name="K1" />}}
Wieler had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin. Wieler was passionate about preventing Ventress from reaching the planet and sent fighters after her ship, though they were unsuccessful in stopping her. Wieler gave the Jedi [[Officer/Legends|officers]] a brief statement when Ventress broke the blockade, and the information about the atmospheric distortion was helpful for the ground forces.<ref name="K1" />

==Equipment==
Wieler wore a [[Republic military uniforms/Legends|uniform]] consisting of a gray-green double-breasted [[shirt]], tan pants, brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with pouches on it. They also wore a brown [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|plaque]] and commanded the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer ''Resilient''.<ref name="K1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wieler first appeared in the [[The Clone Wars 7|seventh issue]] of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. The issue was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], and illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]],<ref name="K1" /> and released on [[July 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-238/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-7|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #7}}</ref>
